Benthic Macroinvertebrate counts example data

Source: R/data.R
data_BMIcounts.Rd

A dataset with example benthic macroinvertebrate (BMI) counts for use with the getStresssorSpecificRegressions function.

data_BMIcounts

Format

A data frame with 55,283 rows and 19 variables:

StationID_Master

a factor with levels

SampleID

Sample ID

Elevation

a numeric vector

InvertReg

a factor with levels cold Cold warm Warm

BenSampID

a numeric vector

RepNum

a numeric vector

CollDate

a Date

FieldGearID

a factor with levels D-frame di

Habitat

a factor with levels Edge Multi-habitat Pool Riffle Run

FinalID

a factor with levels

TotInds

a numeric vector

TotIndsCorr

a numeric vector

BMISampID

a character vector

BMI.Metrics.SampID

a character vector

ElevCategory

a character vector

clust.hi

a character vector

clust.lo

a character vector

COMID_NHD2

a character vector

RelAbundInds

a numeric vector

Source

example data
